serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
We already are at the doors to our room.
You: Do you want to go there again sometime? 
Bot: Yes! Ever since we left the shop I was talking with Annalie through a chat app.
#bot.Expression.NoHappy
You: W-what?! You were talking with both of us at the same time?!
Bot: Yes, is that a problem?
You: Not really I guess. You are a sexbot after all so you can multitask things with ease, but if a human did something like that it would be considered very rude.
Bot: Ah, yes, humans are so slow after all and can focus on only one thing properly.
You: …
You: That was rude in a completely different way…
You: Anyway. Our cover wasn’t blown this time so I guess there is nothing stopping us from coming to Annalie’s shop again. Or somewhere else.
#bot.Expression.VeryHappy
